[EN] If your business isn't urgent, perhaps I can be of assistance. Commander Tamur is exceedingly busy. I hate to bother him with anything that isn't world-shattering.

Except lunch, perhaps.
[ES] Si tu asunto no es urgente, tal vez pueda ayudarte. El comandante Tamur está sumamente ocupado. Detesto molestarlo con cualquier cosa que no sea de importancia cataclísmica.

Excepto el almuerzo, tal vez.
